TUR.scope: Turkey 1990: consolidated central government budget (general and annexed budgets) at 2,608.6 TL per US$, plus social security institutions (SSK, Emekli Sandigi, Bag-Kur) estimated. Funds, state enterprises and local governments not covered.

exps.name: Interest on public debt
exps.note: Domestic and external debt interest, 1990 (20.4% of spending). The game works out debt interest itself, so this line is skipped on import.

exps.name: Public personnel
exps.note: Salaries and social contributions of civil servants, teachers, police and the military, 38.7% of 1990 spending.

exps.name: Public investment
exps.note: Central government capital spending (14.7% of 1990 spending).

exps.name: Transfers to state economic enterprises
exps.note: Budget support to loss-making state economic enterprises.

exps.name: Transfers to local governments, funds and others
exps.note: Shares of tax revenue for municipalities and provinces, transfers to funds and other transfers; 1990 other transfers less estimated social security transfers.

exps.name: Social security benefits (estimated)
exps.note: SSK, Emekli Sandigi and Bag-Kur benefits and costs, estimated midway between 1989 (7.7 trn TL) and 1991 (29.0 trn TL).
